verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Thy word is a lamp unto my feet
and a light unto my path

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Thy word is a lamp unto my feet
and a light unto my path

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
When I feel afraid
and think I've lost my way
Still You're there beside me

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
Nothing will I fear
as long as You are near
Please be near me to the end

verse.name: c2a
verse.lines:
I will not forget
Your love for me and yet
My heart forever is wandering

verse.name: c2b
verse.lines:
Jesus be my guide
and hold me yo Your side
And I will love You to the end
